```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

read_csv_safe <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  csv_df <- utils::read.csv(
    path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE
  )
  if (nrow(csv_df) == 0) NULL else csv_df
}

dt <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(htmltools::tags$p(htmltools::em("No data.")))
  }
  DT::datatable(
    df,
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = "top",
    options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE)
  )
}

tag_class <- c(Critical = "tag-critical", Warning = "tag-warning", Improved = "tag-ok") # nolint: line_length_linter

# Renders `items` as colored pill badges, echoing the colored lists `cli`
# prints to the console for the same critical/warning/improved groupings.
tag_list <- function(items, status) {
  if (length(items) == 0) {
    return('<span class="tag-empty">None</span>')
  }
  paste(
    sprintf('<span class="tag %s">%s</span>', tag_class[[status]], items),
    collapse = " "
  )
}

global_stats <- read_csv_safe(file.path("csv", "global_stats.csv"))
global_rrmse_comparison <- read_csv_safe(
  file.path("csv", "global_rrmse_comparison.csv")
)
```

## Degraded variables

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (is.null(global_rrmse_comparison)) {
  cat("::: {.callout-note}\nNo comparison done.\n:::\n\n")
} else {
  # Mirrors `RRmseComparison$critical_vars`/`warning_vars`/`improved_vars`
  # (and thus what `GlobalEvaluation$summary()` prints to the console):
  # `status` alone isn't enough, `n_obs > 10` is also required.
  reliable <- global_rrmse_comparison[global_rrmse_comparison$n_obs > 10, ]
  by_status <- split(reliable$variable, reliable$status)
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p><strong>%d variable(s) critical</strong> (major rRMSE increase)<br>\n%s</p>\n", # nolint: line_length_linter
    length(by_status[["Critical"]]),
    tag_list(by_status[["Critical"]], "Critical")
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p><strong>%d variable(s) warning</strong> (minor rRMSE increase)<br>\n%s</p>\n", # nolint: line_length_linter
    length(by_status[["Warning"]]),
    tag_list(by_status[["Warning"]], "Warning")
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p><strong>%d variable(s) improved</strong> (rRMSE stable or improved)<br>\n%s</p>\n", # nolint: line_length_linter
    length(by_status[["Improved"]]),
    tag_list(by_status[["Improved"]], "Improved")
  ))
}
```
